senses.gloss: चुञ्चु [cuñcu], a. (At the end of certain comp.) Celebrated, famous, renowned, skilled in; तेन वित्तश्चुञ्चुप्चणपौ P.V. 2.26; अक्षर˚, चार˚ &c. रामो$पि मायाचणमस्त्रचुञ्चुः Bk.2.32.-ञ्चुः The musk-rat or shrew.
A mixed caste born of a Brāhmaṇa father and Vaideha female; मेदान्ध्रचुञ्चु- मद्गूनामारण्यपशुहिंसनम् Ms.1.48.
चुञ्चुरी [cuñcurī], A game played with tamarind seeds instead of dice.
